audits.gaps:
FR-036 parity is NOT guaranteed today. Three measured breaks (regex engine, deterministic, default orchestrator):

GAP-1 (silent PII leak — multi-token span straddling a boundary is MISSED). Batch detects PHONE_NUMBER "415 555 1234" at span (12,24). The same text segmented with `SegmentationPlan(enabled=True, max_tokens=5, overlap_tokens=0)` puts a boundary between "555" and "1234"; NEITHER segment sees the whole number, the regex never matches -> findings EMPTY. `boundary_trace` shows segments_processed=2, merged_spans=0 (nothing merged; the entity just vanished). Parity batch==stream: False. Raising overlap_tokens=3 recovers it. The reconciler CANNOT recover an entity no segment detected — overlap is the only safety net and it is not enforced to exceed the max entity token-length.

GAP-2 (confidence divergence overlap does NOT structurally fix — single-token entity). Batch: EMAIL_ADDRESS "a@b.com" confidence 0.99 (±window context boost from "email"/"invoice" keywords, per engines/regex/confidence.py CONTEXT_WINDOW/CONTEXT_BOOST). Same text, `SegmentationPlan(enabled=True, max_tokens=7, overlap_tokens=0)`: same email, same span, confidence 0.84 — the ±context window was severed by the boundary. The email is a single token (never split), so entity-overlap is irrelevant; only an overlap large enough to also drag the context KEYWORDS into the segment restores 0.99 (ovl=2 did, incidentally). Confidence is load-bearing (fusion thresholds, MoE routing) — a 0.99->0.84 swing can flip a scrub decision at a threshold. `overlap_tokens` is sized for entity length, not for the ±context window, so it does not structurally guarantee confidence parity. The reconciler's max()-confidence merge only helps if SOME segment contains both the entity AND its full context window.

GAP-3 (no parity test). There is no test anywhere asserting stream==batch==offline scrub decisions. The FR-036-tagged A12 test checks reader record-equality only.

GAP-4 (LLM-fed masking does not compose with streaming and is not parity-equal to batch). `FourChannelGuard.intercept` takes a whole `text: str` (no Iterator/chunk composition — verified: no yield/Iterator/chunk on the masking path), and its default masker is regex email/phone ONLY — a different, weaker detector than the orchestrator ensemble. So "masking on the wire" is (a) not streaming-composable and (b) not scrub-parity-equal to the batch detection path by construction. It is explicitly never wired into the orchestrator.

GAP-5 (offline == batch untested + StreamingChunker unused). `run_file` large-text auto-segments via the eager `Segmenter`, so offline large-text inherits GAP-1/GAP-2; there is no test pinning `run_file(large)` scrub decisions == whole-text `run()`. `StreamingChunker` (the memory-bounded path) is API-exposed but never exercised by detection.

plan.phase_b_decision:
DECISION: Do Phase B as FUSION RECALIBRATION first (config/strategy, no learned weights); escalate to a learned meta-learner retrain ONLY if measured headroom remains after recalibration. Net verdict: the recalibration is clearly worth it (biggest single lever on foreign datasets); a full learned retrain is NOT clearly worth it and is gated behind measured evidence.

WHY: The measured bottleneck is that SwarmFusionStrategy DISCARDS complementary channels on foreign taxonomies (ai4privacy: gliner 597 gold-matches -> only 298 survive; tab: 26/124 IoU-1.0 gliner spans die post-fusion; piibench: 4,068 reachable gold spans suppressed as low-corroboration singletons, meta_score caps 0.62<0.85 override). The sp6 cand-2 counterfactual — per-(engine,type) single-engine acceptance + post-fusion precision/boundary gates + emission-gate recalibration — lifts tab relaxed R 0.091->0.582 (F2 ~0.10->~0.55) and is largely a fusion-STRATEGY/config change, not a learned-weights retrain. Prior memory ([swarm-two-fusion-paths]) established that training the MoE meta-learner is floor-locked to core on the HOME substrate and NOT worth it — that finding stands; the foreign-taxonomy channel-discard is a different, config-addressable problem. So: recalibrate fusion config first (cheap, no data-provenance burden), measure per-dataset, and only fund a learned retrain against the residual gap.

IF a learned retrain is funded, it REQUIRES:
1. DISJOINT DATA — train/tune on the upstream TRAIN split ONLY. nemotron: only test-00000-of-00001.parquet is local; test is NEVER mined or tuned. Same discipline for all five: no dataset's test/eval split (the one producing the headline metric) may enter training or threshold tuning. Candidate-labeling uses the sp6 candidate-labeling API + confidence-aware NER pass-through, sourced from train only.
2. CANDIDATE-LABELING — the candidate-labeling API + confidence-aware NER pass-through + emission-gate recalibration (piibench Phase-B recipe), so gliner/presidio channels are labeled candidates the gate can learn to keep rather than structurally suppress.
3. SIGNING + VERIFY-ON-LOAD — the retrained gate artifact (gate_v*.json) MUST carry a pinned signature/hash and be checked by the verify-on-load entry-gate invariant every gate reader enforces ([moe-router-gate-seam]); the md5 pin ([sdo-gate-invariants]) prevents a tuned-on-test or fabricated gate from shipping. Route the artifact through eval_framework/validation/no_fabrication.py (no-fabrication invariants).
4. MANDATORY ADVERSARIAL CLOSE — any retrain touches the masking-path control seam, so the adversarial-close catch-net is MANDATORY ([sdo-gate-invariants]: run for ANY gate/producer/control-path change; the close is the only reliable certifier). A privacy-attack/eval FEATURE alone flips no SDO guarantee, but a fusion-gate retrain DOES change the control path — close required. Re-run the full suite BEFORE dispatching any review gate (concurrent reviewer pytest clobbers .coverage).

Guardrail: keep the recalibration subtractive-on-mask/default-to-mask — recovering a discarded channel must ADD masking, never enable a path that drops a candidate; the re-id DIRECTION inversion class (assurance Phase 2 caught 2) means any acceptance-rule change must be verified monotone-safe.

NON-STRIPPABLE CAVEATS (both structurally enforced):
(a) NFR-016 ANTI_ANONYMITY_CAVEAT — default + __post_init__-re-asserted field on ReidSuccessMetrics/ReidPowerCell/ReidPowerLadder/MiaSuccessReport/SecretSharerReport/MiaPowerReport, present in every as_outcome(); a blank caveat raises ValueError. Cannot be stripped.
(b) Under-power at user scale — RRS rungs 385/897, MIA >=128 shadow; a user-scale corpus reports powered=false (measured 2<385 re-id, 4<128 MIA), so the bound ships ADVISORY, NEVER MEASURED, with the Wilson CI as the honest interval (measured tiny-n: re-id [0.342,1.0], MIA [0.510,1.0]).

HONEST-BOUND WORDING (mandatory, verbatim intent): "Under adversary class X (representative Tier-3 QIC/BSL re-identifier with auxiliary knowledge Y at candidate-set size Z / representative MIA loss-threshold at declared shadow count / the 4-channel injection+leak guard), measured re-id success <= [Wilson upper] and MIA TPR@1e-3 <= [value]. This is a BOUND against THESE specified adversary classes at THIS (ADVISORY, under-powered) statistical power — NOT a guarantee against all adversaries, and NEVER a claim that re-identification is impossible or that the text is anonymized." The real-LLM row (if included) is labelled non-deterministic/API-keyed/ADVISORY and never contributes to a headline.

FR-036 PARITY PRECONDITION (gates report validity): the masking used to build the substrate MUST be proven stream==batch==offline. Add the golden-parity test asserting identical scrub decisions (entity_type, corrected GLOBAL span, AND confidence) for whole-text run() vs segmented run() vs run_file() offline, parametrized over overlap_tokens {0, small, large}, plus a byte-identical-across-two-runs determinism pin (extends FR-030 to the segmented path). This is a GATE because two measured breaks make the resistance bound wrong: GAP-1 (multi-token PHONE "415 555 1234" split across a max_tokens=5/overlap=0 boundary -> BOTH segments miss it -> findings EMPTY, silent PII leak on stream/offline; the reconciler cannot recover an entity no segment detected) and GAP-2 (single-token EMAIL confidence 0.99 batch -> 0.84 stream when the +-context window is severed, flipping threshold decisions). If parity fails, the re-id substrate is masked MORE completely than production actually masks, so the bound understates real leakage. Fix (boundary-safety: enforce overlap_tokens >= configured max_entity_tokens with auto-bump/loud-error, OR seam re-detection pass; context-window halo distinct from dedup overlap) BEFORE trusting any Phase-C number. Also note StreamingChunker is API-exposed but detection-path-dead (run_file uses the eager Segmenter), and FourChannelGuard.intercept takes whole strings with a regex-only default masker — neither is streaming-composable nor batch-parity-equal today.

plan.risks:
R1 LEAK-DIRECTION INVERSION (sp2 SHOWSTOPPER) — an eval-time FP-suppression/DROP optimization that improves the score by dropping candidates on the MASKING path leaks PII in production. Mitigation: every Phase-A FP-suppression (esp. A1 Title-Case veto) and Phase-B acceptance rule is architected default-to-mask / subtractive-on-mask (demote-confidence or eval-scoring-only); an eval-time drop must NEVER run on the masking path. This is the top risk.

R2 RE-ID DIRECTION INVERSION (assurance Phase-2 caught 2) — a re-id/linkability metric measuring the wrong direction; a "lower bound" that is actually an upper bound. Mitigation: reuse the MONOTONE compacted-substring linkability lower bound; keep the Tier-3/MIA scorers ADVISORY + Wilson-bounded; verify any acceptance-rule change is monotone-safe.

R3 MANDATORY ADVERSARIAL CLOSE — required on ANY masking-path / gate / producer / control-path change (STEP-1 boundary fix, Phase-A masking gates, Phase-B recalibration/retrain, Phase-C egress). The close is the only reliable certifier ([sdo-gate-invariants]); pin the gate md5. Run the full pytest suite BEFORE dispatching the review-gate workflow (concurrent reviewer pytest clobbers .coverage).

R4 FR-036 BOUNDARY SILENT-DROP (GAP-1, measured) — a multi-token PII entity split across a chunk boundary is silently dropped (PHONE "415 555 1234" -> EMPTY at overlap=0); GAP-2 confidence 0.99->0.84 flips threshold decisions. Blocks Phase-C validity (substrate would be masked more than production). Fix in STEP 1.

R5 TEST-LEAKAGE / DATA PROVENANCE — Phase-B tuning on a test/eval split inflates the headline. Mitigation: TRAIN-split only (nemotron: only test parquet is local; test never mined/tuned); signed gate + verify-on-load + no_fabrication invariants prevent a tuned-on-test or fabricated gate from shipping.

R6 OVERCLAIMING — never "anonymized" / "impossible". Bounds are ADVISORY + Wilson CI + powered=false at user scale; NFR-016 caveat is structurally non-strippable. The guarantee is a bound vs specified adversary classes at a stated (under-)power, full stop.

R7 CEILING-CHASING — chasing oracle-perfect/gold-noise (0.83-0.96) burns effort on taxonomy/convention/partial-annotation residue (SURNAME/BUILDINGNUM split, MISC/FINANCIAL_ENTITY grab-bags, FIRST/LAST split, TIME, gretel partial-annotation precision ceiling, tab ORG-unreachable-in-pool + free-standing years/counts/durations). Targets are pinned to the no-new-model perfect-fusion ceiling; do NOT chase past it without a product-scope call (new native types / new NER / eval-side sub-span credit = out of no-new-model scope).

R9 REAL-LLM ROW HAZARDS — API-keyed + non-deterministic; MUST run OUTSIDE the egress-denying sandbox (_EgressGuard raises SandboxViolation on any socket connect); ADVISORY only, never a MEASURED headline; scored by the identical pure score_reid_attack.
